text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm at the shopping
district...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yay! Super discounted protein bars,
acquired!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Thanks for getting the balloon back for
me!
text_block_list.name: Child

text_block_list.text: No problem! Just hold it tight this time!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin seems to be flexing her
explosive power
even while she shops.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Waaah, Ineeees!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Hello, hello! Didn't you say you
were
going on your first date ever
today?
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: Yeah... But he's not showing up!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
I messaged him, but he hasn't even read
it. I
wonder if something happened.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
I thought about going to his house to
check up on
him, but if I've just been
stood up, I'll look silly.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, he might come if you wait a
bit
longer... or it might be a waste of
your time.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
In times like these, you need to be brave
and just
go and see!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
On the off chance that something's
happened to
him, you can still make it in
time if you rush!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
You're right! I'll go and check! Thanks,
Ines!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Good luck! I know everything'll turn out
fine!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: ...I know it will. For you... and me.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Gyah?! You... You're from Tracen
Academy,
right?
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: I was just saying... uh, how do I put this?
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
A long time ago, when I was having
trouble with
something, someone else
helped give me a push.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
That girl just now reminded me of myself
back
then. That's why I couldn't resist
stepping in.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Doors won't open if you just sit around
and wait.
Which is why we open them
ourselves.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
It's about knowing where you want to
go, and
getting there faster than
anyone... Just gotta take
that first step
with conviction!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Listening to Ines Fujin's words and
seeing her
perspective really boosts my
courage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
